sentences.en: I found it truly regrettable that he should take offence.
sentences.zh: 我真遗憾他会因此感到冒犯。

sentences.en: She meant no particular offence, and her friend took none.
sentences.zh: 她并没有特别想冒犯谁，她的朋友也没有介意。

sentences.en: When somebody rebukes him for anything, he easily takes offence.
sentences.zh: 每当有人因为什么事责备他时，他就很容易生气。

senses.zh: 犯罪；过错；攻击，冒犯；令人讨厌的事物
